name: What information does an electrician need before sub-trade coordination can start?

mainEntity.name: What information does an electrician need before sub-trade coordination can start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most projects need a clear scope sheet, floor plan, fixture schedule, panel information, and the order of trade work. The electrician also needs to know what each other trade is touching, such as cabinets, drywall, HVAC runs, insulation, and low-voltage systems. Missing details about device locations, switch heights, or appliance loads are common causes of delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need drawings, scope details, fixture and device locations, panel data, and a clear sequence for the other trades.
